description: Conditional volatility forecasts: EWMA (RiskMetrics, λ=0.94), HAR-RV (Corsi), and GARCH(1,1) fitted by maximum likelihood with Gaussian or Student-t innovations. Returns fitted params (omega/alpha/beta/dof), persistence, long-run vol, half-life, and a multi-horizon (1/5/21-day) forecast. Alpha tier. Use to forecast next-day/forward volatility or gauge vol mean-reversion. Pass dist='gaussian' or 'student_t' (default student_t).

apiKey.description: FlashAlpha API key. Omit when calling via /mcp-oauth (OAuth flow); required on /mcp.
